name: Simple Balance
tagline: Free budget app and spending tracker: ask about your money, and queue or record transactions
description:
Simple Balance is a free budget app and spending tracker. Every account is on one page, and any total you doubt opens into the payments behind it. This is its hosted MCP server at `https://app.smpl.money/mcp` (Streamable HTTP), with up to 77 tools: accounts and balances, transactions and splits, categories and payees, budgets and forecasts, reports, bank statement imports, recurring transactions and templates, and the activity history.

You decide how far it goes. Sign-in is OAuth in your browser with dynamic client registration and PKCE, so there's no API key to paste, and the **Allow this MCP client?** screen lists the scopes being requested: `ledger:read` reads, `ledger:stage` queues transactions for you to approve, and `ledger:write` makes the change itself. Tools outside the grant are left out of the tool list. Deleting your account, setting a password and billing are never reachable over MCP, and Settings lists every connected assistant and cuts one off when you want it gone.

There's no automatic pull from your bank today: you download the file your bank gives you and bring it in. Simple Balance keeps track of your money; it can't move it. The server is open source (AGPL-3.0) at https://github.com/thtmnisamnstr/simple-balance, so you can also self-host it, on a computer you control.

Docs: https://smpl.money/docs/agents-and-mcp/

install.notes: After installing, connect your Simple Balance account. In VS Code or JetBrains, open MCP Servers, find simple-balance and press Authenticate. In the CLI, run `cline mcp` and choose Authorize OAuth. Sign in, then choose Allow access. Cline asks before each tool call unless you auto-approve it, so keep write tools out of autoApprove.
